figurative_meaning_en: In praise: an ideal truth-teller like Yudhishthir
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সততা দেখে মনে হয় সে ধর্মপুত্র যুধিষ্ঠির।
এই কাজে তুমি ধর্মপুত্র যুধিষ্ঠিরের মতো সত্যবাদী হয়েছ।
example_sentences_in_english: His steadfastness makes him seem like Dharmaputra Yudhishthir.
In this task, you proved as truthful as Dharmaputra Yudhishthir.
history: Refers to Yudhishthir, the eldest Pandava brother in the Hindu epic Mahabharata, epitomized as Dharmaputra for his unwavering commitment to righteousness, truth, and dharma despite moral dilemmas like the dice game.
note: This idiom draws from ancient Indian mythology, emphasizing ethical ideals in Bengali linguistic tradition.
